purpose: Encode the reproducible parts of the observed manual fast-rotation wins while preventing a scalp from silently becoming an unlimited hold.

transition_contract.OBSERVE_to_DIRECTION_READY: completed evidence produces one pair-specific direction with three recorded reasons and explicit opposing evidence
transition_contract.DIRECTION_READY_to_ENTRY_ELIGIBLE: execution, cost, margin, inventory, and unwind stages are complete; missing never passes
transition_contract.ENTRY_ELIGIBLE_to_HOLD_MONITOR: fill is confirmed; entry-frozen thesis and time budget are persisted
transition_contract.HOLD_MONITOR_to_EXIT_REQUESTED: first of profit harvest, activated loss budget, thesis invalidation, spread failure, or time budget fires
transition_contract.EXIT_REQUESTED_to_CLOSE_CONFIRMED: broker close fill is read back; intent alone is insufficient
transition_contract.CLOSE_CONFIRMED_to_REENTRY_WAIT_FRESH_EV: rotation may begin immediately, but the prior thesis is invalidated and cannot be reused
transition_contract.REENTRY_WAIT_FRESH_EVIDENCE_to_REENTRY_E: new pair-specific evidence and full risk packet pass
transition_contract.any_to_FAIL_CLOSED: missing ownership, quote, costs, margin, unwind, or conflicting evidence

research_parameter_derivation.profit_floor_jpy: minimum realized P/L among the four frozen wins
research_parameter_derivation.max_hold_seconds: ceiling to one minute of the maximum holding time among the four frozen wins
research_parameter_derivation.loss_budget_activation_seconds: floor to one minute of the minimum holding time among the four frozen wins; prevents the entry spread from being mislabeled as thesis failure while remaining an in-sample diagnostic
research_parameter_derivation.loss_budget_fraction: 0.25% of entry equity, inherited from CAPITAL_PRESERVATION_GATE_V1
research_parameter_derivation.note: These values describe the four wins and are not out-of-sample parameters or live constants.

margin_closeout_contract.effect: blocks immediate reentry until flatness, ownership, full margin, cost, and fresh-thesis evidence are read back

integration.technical_and_price_action: supply direction and invalidation evidence; do not directly place orders
integration.forecast: supplies calibrated edge and uncertainty when causally archived; missing means WAIT
integration.continuous_thesis: compares entry-frozen thesis with new completed evidence during HOLD_MONITOR
integration.multidimensional_cube: normalizes one opinion per independent family and preserves dissent/missing cells
integration.trailing_and_BE: eligible only after after-cost activation and next-quote effectiveness; never retroactive same-bar
integration.hedge: risk/unwind diagnostic only; does not create edge and requires an explicit executable unwind
integration.fusion: returns one of TRADE, WAIT, SKIP, MANAGE; execution/risk families constrain but never invent edge

reentry_contract.same_pair_or_cross_pair: both allowed only after pair-specific fresh evidence
